adjudication.rationale: In handleNewBooking.ts, evt.destinationCalendar is set to `null` when neither `eventType.destinationCalendar` nor `organizerUser.destinationCalendar` exists (`destinationCalendar: ... : null,`). Immediately after, team member calendars are appended via `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars);`. If `evt.destinationCalendar` is null, the optional-chained `push` is a no-op, so `teamDestinationCalendars` collected from `users.slice(1)` are dropped and never make it into the CalendarEvent. This is a correctness issue in the new multi-destination-calendar logic for COLLECTIVE team events.
